methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $254M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 1 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.0x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

private.name: SambaNova Systems
private.rationale: Same sector (Chips & Semiconductors), same stage (Series A), post-money $11B

data.narrative:
Black Semiconductor is a Series A semiconductor company founded by Daniel Schall and Sebastian Schall, having raised €254.4M to date. The valuation universe spans 12 private and 3 public peers in Chips & Semiconductors, including public comparables ALAB, NVDA, and AMD, and private peers such as SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, and Etched.

Of three triangulation methods assessed, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. The Peer-Median approach was inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set matches—while 12 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three qualified within narrow filters of stage, timing, or valuation tier. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed because Black Semiconductor's revenue is not on file; the public semiconductor universe trades at a median 21.0x price-to-sales, but this multiple cannot be applied without target revenue disclosure.

Stage-Progression applies a 2.0x multiplier to the €254.4M raised proxy, implying a valuation of €509M. The analysis derives a range of €432M (low) to €585M (high) centered on €509M, reflecting ±15% variance around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable transaction multiples in the semiconductor peer set and the unavailability of target revenue metrics, which would enable public-comp cross-checks and narrow the band. Resolution of revenue disclosure would strengthen conviction in this range.
